fusions.name: Hopper's Pounce
fusions.desc: Springs you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nape Bite
fusions.desc: A killing bite on an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 18 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Springing Legs
fusions.desc: A leap that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: One Always Escapes
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
